title: EEG Emotion Recognition From AI-Generated Biodigital Architecture Images
abstract: arXiv:2607.24808v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Emotional responses to biodigital architecture were examined using electroencephalographic (EEG) data from AI-generated images. A pre-experiment involving 336 participants identified 60 images, selected from an initial pool of 600, that elicited strong emotional responses categorized as awe, disgust, or content. These images were used for EEG recordings of 52 volunteers, with channel selection and sample size estimation based on the analysis of an existing dataset. Gamma and delta bands yielded the highest classification accuracy, with the gamma band achieving an accuracy of 77.07 percent +/- 13.8 percent for the awe emotion. Key factors such as greenery and non-uniform granularity were linked to positive emotions, while dampness triggered negative reactions. translated_title: 基于AI生成生物数字建筑图像的脑电图情绪识别
translated_abstract: 摘要：本研究利用AI生成图像中的脑电图（EEG）数据，考察了生物数字建筑引发的情绪反应。一项涉及336名参与者的预实验从600张初始图像中筛选出60张，这些图像能引发强烈情绪反应，分类为敬畏、厌恶或满足。这些图像随后用于52名志愿者的EEG记录，通道选择和样本量估算基于现有数据集的分析。伽马和德尔塔频段取得了最高的分类准确率，其中伽马频段对敬畏情绪的分类准确率达到77.07%±13.8%。关键因素如绿化和非均匀颗粒感与积极情绪相关，而潮湿感则引发负面反应。这些结果强调了在生物数字建筑中融入自然元素和多样纹理以提升美学吸引力和接受度的重要性。
tldr: 本研究通过EEG分析AI生成的生物数字建筑图像，发现伽马频段对敬畏情绪识别准确率最高（77.07%），并揭示绿化和非均匀纹理促进积极情绪，而潮湿感引发负面反应，为优化建筑设计提供了神经科学依据。
en_tdlr: This study uses EEG to analyze AI-generated biodigital architecture images, achieving 77.07% accuracy in recognizing awe via the gamma band, and finds greenery and non-uniform textures enhance positive emotions while dampness triggers negative reactions, offering neuroscientific insights for architectural design.
